name: Shobhad Hunter (7-8)
source: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future

items.name: Falchion
items.description: This weapon is a heavier, two-handed version of the curved-bladed scimitar. It is weighted toward the blade's end, making it a powerful slashing weapon.

items.name: Javelin
items.description: This thin spear is well balanced for throwing but is not designed for melee use.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

generalAbilities.name: Cold Adaptation
generalAbilities.description: Shobhads reduce the effects they suffers from cold environments by one step.

defensiveAbilities.name: Ferocity
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger The monster is reduced to 0 HP.

Effect The monster avoids being knocked out and remains at 1 HP, but its Wounded value increases by 1. When it is Wounded 3, it can no longer use this ability

defensiveAbilities.name: Shield Block
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger The monster has its shield raised and takes damage from a physical attack.

Effect The monster snaps its shield into place to deflect a blow. The shield prevents the monster from taking an amount of damage up to the shield's Hardness. The monster and the shield each take any remaining damage, possibly breaking or destroying the shield.

offensiveAbilities.name: Determined Charge
offensiveAbilities.description: The shobhad hunter Strides, ignoring non-magical difficult terrain and uneven ground. If the shobhad ends their movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, they can make a melee Strike against that enemy.

offensiveAbilities.name: Four-Armed
offensiveAbilities.description: Shobhads have four arms, which allows them to wield and hold up to four hands' worth of weapons and equipment. While this increases the number of items they can have at the ready, it doesn't increase the number of actions shobhads can take during combat.

offensiveAbilities.name: Four-Armed
offensiveAbilities.description: Shobhads have four arms, which allows them to wield and hold up to four hands' worth of weapons and equipment. While this increases the number of items they can have at the ready, it doesn't increase the number of actions shobhads can take during combat.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hunt Prey
offensiveAbilities.description: The shobhad hunter designates a single creature they can see and hear, or one they're Tracking, as their prey. The shobhad hunter gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Seek the prey and to Survival checks to Track the prey. This effect lasts until the shobhad hunter uses Hunt Prey again.

offensiveAbilities.name: Precision Edge
offensiveAbilities.description: The first time the shobhad hunter hits their hunted prey in a round, they deal an additional 1d8 precision damage.
